info.name: ER-0020 Samsara Vehicle Fault Proof
info.description: Synthetic/local Samsara Webhooks 1.0-shape proof based on ER-0019 research and official documentation. It is not production-grade Samsara support. Production readiness requires a sanitized representative Alert Webhooks 2.0 payload.

exec: if (!secret) throw new Error('Set samsara_webhook_secret to the Base64 webhook secret.');
pm.test('Samsara synthetic fault is processed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('processed'); });

pm.test('Relay maps only the vehicle-fault category', () => { const normalized = pm.response.json().normalized; pm.expect(normalized.source).to.eql('samsara'); pm.expect(normalized.category).to.eql('samsara.vehicle.fault_detected'); pm.expect(normalized.tags.logistics.eventId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('samsara_event_id')); });

body.raw:
{
  "eventId": "{{samsara_event_id}}",
  "eventMs": 1600792716481,
  "eventType": "Alert",
  "event": {
    "alertEventUrl": "https://cloud.samsara.example/alerts/synthetic-vehicle-fault",
    "alertConditionDescription": "Vehicle has fault",
    "alertConditionId": "DeviceHasVehicleFault",
    "details": "SYNTHETIC LOCAL PROOF: Vehicle 'Little Red' reported a fault. SPN: 627, FMI: 4.",
    "device": { "id": 281474977075805, "name": "Little Red", "serial": "SYNTHETIC-G9MTH7CNKZ", "vin": "SYNTHETIC-VIN-ONLY" },
    "orgId": 53729,
    "resolved": false,
    "startMs": 1600792612258,
    "summary": "Vehicle 'Little Red' reported a fault."
  }
}

exec: pm.test('Invalid Samsara signature is rejected', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('signature mismatch'); });
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set samsara_webhook_secret to the Base64 webhook secret.');

pm.test('Unsupported Samsara alert fails closed', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const response = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(response.status).to.eql('failed'); pm.expect(response.normalized.category).to.be.undefined; });
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set samsara_webhook_secret to the Base64 webhook secret.');
pm.test('Repeated Samsara eventId is idempotent', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('duplicate'); });
